findings.claim: At toiminnot v1.3.0 (4763b907) the two hook actions' action.yaml files are swapped relative to their names and READMEs: actions/prek runs pip-installed pre-commit 4.2.0, while actions/pre_commit runs prek (input prek_version, default 0.2.25). The plan picks actions/prek and so moves CI off prek onto pre-commit, dropping the prek version the justfile pins (0.5.5) that test_ci_prek_job_runs_all_files_at_justfile_version ties CI to. The repo's hooks, justfile and rules standardize on prek; the plan never weighs actions/pre_commit with prek_version: "0.5.5", which keeps the tool and the pin. Choose one: use actions/pre_commit with prek_version matched to the justfile (and keep a test tying the two), or record the operator's acceptance that CI runs pre-commit 4.2.0 instead of prek. Either way the plan and r1 should name the swap, since a later toiminnot release that fixes it would change behaviour on a SHA bump.
The plan picked actions/prek by name, but at v1.3.0 it runs pre-commit; actions/pre_commit runs prek.
